objective: Improve end-to-end long-dialog memory on mainstream benchmarks with a five-stage, evidence-grounded evolving memory mechanism.

sources.paper: A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
sources.difference: Keep immutable source evidence; avoid replacing factual history with rewritten contextual notes.

sources.paper: Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory
sources.transfer: Separate observed time and event time; retain historical state versions
sources.difference: Conservative state chains rather than LLM invalidation; no unsupported validity interval claims.

sources.paper: SimpleMem: Efficient Lifelong Memory for LLM Agents
sources.transfer: Self-contained facts with pronoun and date resolution
sources.difference: Attach original source turns and use evidence closure within a fixed token budget; no recursive lossy replacement.

sources.transfer: Separate source facts and synthesized retrieval views; multi-strategy recall
sources.difference: Initial prototype uses no agent opinions or disposition system. Strong published system to compare later, not reproduced yet.

sources.paper: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
sources.transfer: Separate persistent relational state from request-specific evidence applicability and role
sources.difference: Zero-shot API evidence compiler with immutable provenance and bounded final reader context; no RL policy training or ontology copying.

sources.paper: JustMem: Just-Enough Memory Access for Long-Term Conversations
sources.transfer: Separate memory keys from recoverable source values; avoid uniform context expansion
sources.difference: Fuse lexical and semantic views at immutable source IDs; deduplicate and pack original source turns chronologically. The selected prototype does not use their access-mode planner.

sources.paper: EverMemOS: A Self-Organizing Memory Operating System
sources.transfer: Consolidated semantic structures and source-aware reconstruction
sources.difference: Track-specific canonical attributes retain individual observations; no full MemScene lifecycle or foresight system. Published accuracy is not directly comparable to token F1.

hypotheses.claim: Question-blind atomic facts increase multi-hop evidence recall under a fixed context budget.
hypotheses.decision: raw vs facts on development conversations before a heldout evaluation

hypotheses.claim: Evidence and state-chain closure improves reference resolution and current-state correctness.
hypotheses.decision: facts vs evolved; LongMemEval knowledge-update needed because first LoCoMo conversation has zero state-chain edges

evaluation.locomo_metric: Unchanged official Porter-stemmed F1 functions, categories 1-4; adversarial category 5 reported separately if run.
evaluation.status: Development only; no SOTA claim. Published scores with different backbones, metrics, data versions or budgets are not controlled comparisons.

longmemeval_s.note: Copied read-only from local cache; direct upstream download was slow and stopped. No prior experimental outputs reused.

protocol_update: Initial text-only LoCoMo results omit captions and remain ablations. Standard-input runs use blip_caption and exclude image search query. Evidence annotations are normalized to Dn:m IDs, including compound labels.
